text:
tay: Customer reports starter quickstart returns 402 with no helpful guidance. They accepted an SSO invite and used the sample curl.

lee: Do we have the raw response? 402 could be billing_required or mis-scoped key.

tay: Copied from user: HTTP/1.1 402
Body: {"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"workspace_incomplete"}}

sam: Ok that's onboarding. Problem: CLI prints "Request failed (402)" and the SDK raises a generic ApiError. We should surface the server error.message and, if present, an onboarding_url.

devex-bot: Tracking: DEVEX-730 - Surface onboarding errors in CLI/SDK. Workaround doc: https://go.redwood/onboard-ssogap

ops: Short-term support note: ask SSO-invite customers to visit console > Billing or https://console.redwood-inference.test/onboarding to complete setup. Adding to playbook.

sam: Proposal: API include onboarding_required:true and onboarding_url when org.state != "active". SDKs map to WorkspaceOnboardingRequired error with .onboarding_url property. I'll draft SDK PR.

tay: Customer completed billing and first call succeeded. Leaving this thread for follow-up when PRs land.
